info.title: Meta Service
info.description: Wraps the Meta (Facebook) Graph API v22.0 for ad account management, performance reporting, and organic posting.

AdCopy.description: Text only. No image is supplied and none is generated: Meta renders the destination page's own link preview.

customEventType.description: Required when goal is OFFSITE_CONVERSIONS, e.g. PURCHASE, LEAD, ADD_TO_CART, COMPLETE_REGISTRATION.

OptimizationGoal.description: What the ad set optimises delivery for. Per campaign, and changeable afterwards: the right event moves one step deeper down the funnel as volume accrues.

customEventType.description: Required when goal is OFFSITE_CONVERSIONS, e.g. PURCHASE, LEAD, ADD_TO_CART, COMPLETE_REGISTRATION.

authorizationUrl.description: Send the user here to log into Threads

expiresAt.description: The login must finish before this time (15 minutes)

brandId.description: Brand the account is connected to

redirectUri.description: Page Threads sends the user back to with `code` and `state`. Must be registered, byte for byte, as a redirect callback URL of our Threads app.

AccountType.description: Who runs the account: `pro_human` = Pro (human), `personal_human` = Personal (human), `pro_ai` = Pro (AI)

created.description: false when this Threads account was already connected to the brand: it was refreshed, not duplicated

accountTypeLabel.description: Human label of accountType, e.g. Pro (AI)

health.description: `needs_reconnect` = Threads no longer accepts this login; a human must connect it again

healthReason.description: Plain-language reason when health is needs_reconnect

postId.description: Threads media id of the published post

publicationId.description: This service's record of the publication (the outcome's subject)

kind.description: `post` = a main post (one `post_published` outcome); `reply` = a reply under a post (part of its thread, no outcome)

threadRootPostId.description: Threads id of the main post of this thread (itself for a post)

replayed.description: true when the idempotency key had already published this: nothing was published again

declared.description: false = runs-service refused or was unreachable; retried by the next call with the same idempotency key

outcome.description: The `post_published` outcome declared on the caller's run (x-run-id), main posts only; null for a reply

text.description: Post text, at most 500 characters (Threads' limit)

replyToPostId.description: Publish as a reply under this Threads post id (e.g. the postId a previous call returned)

idempotencyKey.description: Caller's own key, unique per org. The same key again answers the publication it already made (200, `replayed: true`) and never calls Threads twice. The same key with another account, text or parent post is a 409 `idempotency_key_reused`.

kind.description: `post` = a main post (one `post_published` outcome); `reply` = a reply under a post (part of its thread, no outcome)

outcomeDeclaredAt.description: When post_published landed on runs-service (on runId)

raw.description: Threads' answer verbatim (bronze for the caller)

post.summary: Publish a text post, or a reply under a post, on a connected Threads account (kept on record, idempotent on the caller's key)
post.description: Every publication is kept (account, brand, org, user, run, campaign, kind, parent post, text, permalink, time). A main post declares ONE `post_published` outcome on the caller's run (x-run-id), subject = the publication; a reply declares none. The Threads API is free: no cost.

409.description: `reason: needs_reconnect` (+ `accountId`): Threads no longer accepts the account's login. `reason: idempotency_key_reused` / `publish_in_progress` (+ `publicationId`): the key names another publication, or its publish is still in flight.

502.description: Threads refused the call (carries Threads' code and message), or our Threads app credentials are not configured (names the key)

get.summary: Live lifetime insights of one Threads MAIN post (views, likes, replies, reposts, quotes, shares), read on the account that published it. Free, stores nothing: social-service keeps the series and declares post_viewed / post_engaged (FACTORY-P2-CONTENT-OUTCOMES).

200.description: The post's insights; a metric Threads did not return is null, never 0

409.description: Not readable now, `reason`: `needs_reconnect` (Threads no longer accepts the login), `insights_scope_missing` (connected without threads_manage_insights), `insights_permission_missing` (our Meta app lacks the permission: Threads code 10), `not_measurable` (a reply, unpublished, or the account is gone)
